basis: Benign lymphoid-cell proliferation; resemblance to lymphoma does not establish an autoimmune, infectious or other immune-mediated disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: reactive lymphoid proliferation alone does not establish a qualifying immune mechanism; pseudolymphoma is not lymphoma.

basis: PLG-associated angioedema characteristically affects skin and oral tissues; recurrent tongue swelling occurs in about 78%. Bradykinin mediation does not establish immune disease.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: recurrent tongue and oral mucosal angioedema is a defining presentation of PLG-associated disease; tongue swelling affects about 78%.

basis: CEL-related monogenic diabetes; intrinsic exocrine pancreatic dysfunction affects most patients (>30%) and often precedes diabetes.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: exocrine pancreatic dysfunction affects most patients and is intrinsic to CEL-MODY; the supplied definition identifies the primary disease as diabetes.

basis: Progressive joint stiffness, enamel hypoplasia and intellectual disability define the syndrome. Frequent eyelid and pinna dysmorphism lacks documented functional impairment.

decisions.ocular: none: blepharophimosis occurs in 30-79%, but the described narrow fissures and epicanthus do not establish damaging ocular dysfunction.

basis: Purine-synthesis enzyme deficiency defines a spectrum encompassing peripheral neuropathy and sensorineural hearing loss; optic atrophy is subtype-dependent.

decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss defines the nonsyndromic hearing-loss presentation and is characteristic across the Arts/CMTX5 spectrum.

basis: Lysosomal metabolic disease with progressive neurodegeneration; damaging retinal involvement at a frequency of at least 30% is not established for this specific form.

decisions.ocular: none: the supplied evidence does not establish retinal degeneration or visual loss in at least 30% of late-infantile CLN10 patients.

basis: Arteriovenous malformations of cerebral, orbital and facial territories define the syndrome; additional tissue involvement varies across subtypes.

decisions.ocular: primary: orbital vascular malformations are expressly included in the syndrome's defining anatomic spectrum.

basis: Muscle weakness and abnormal muscle mitochondria support myopathy; ophthalmoplegia and ptosis (20/20) define ocular dysfunction. Independent nerve damage is not established.

decisions.neurologic: none: the unquantified cranial-nerve morphology annotation does not establish a defining neuropathy or common independent nerve damage beyond myopathic ophthalmoplegia.

basis: Locally infiltrating syringomatous adnexal neoplasm of nipple dermis/subcutis with sweat-duct differentiation supports a cutaneous site.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: this locally infiltrating syringomatous tumor occupies nipple dermis/subcutis and has sweat-duct differentiation, supporting the skin axis.

basis: Proteasome-associated autoinflammation; hypertriglyceridemia in 1/1 lacks evidence of persistent metabolic dysfunction. Rash and organomegaly alone do not establish additional damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypertriglyceridemia in 1/1 establishes occurrence, but does not establish persistent lipid dysfunction or direct metabolic damage.
